_readme: Signature ledger for the Singhouse Contributor License Agreements
This file is the record of who is covered. It is read by the CLA check in
.github/workflows/cla.yml, which reads it FROM THE BASE BRANCH — so an
entry only counts once the Owner has merged it. Adding yourself inside the
pull request you want unblocked does not work, and is not meant to.
To sign as an individual, see CONTRIBUTING.md. Do not edit anyone else's
Matching is on the numeric GitHub account id, never the login: logins are
mutable and GitHub releases them for reuse after an account is deleted, so
a login is not a stable identity for a legal record. Find yours at
_cla_version_note: Prepared version; intake is not active until the required status and owner-only merge controls are configured and tested. Material revisions require fresh acceptance.
_owners_note: These are authorized account representatives of Bones Consulting LLC, not individual copyright-owner claims or contributor signatures. Owner exemptions cover authorized company submissions; they do not cover unrelated third-party work. Verify each numeric account ID before activation.

_signature_format.login: your GitHub login at the time of signing, for human readability
_signature_format.id: your numeric GitHub account id — this is what the check matches on
_signature_format.name: your full legal name — the agreement is with a person, not an account
_signature_format.email: a contact email address for CLA matters
_signature_format.employer: OPTIONAL: employer or client with rights in your work, per Section 6(c) — omit if none
_signature_format.cla_version: the value of cla_version above, at the time you signed
_signature_format.reference: URL of the pull request in which you signed

_note: Organizations sign CCLA.md offline, so these entries are added by the
Owner from the executed agreement — never by a contributor pull request.
The CCLA's alternative Schedule A form — a tick-box designating everyone
at a given email domain — cannot be enforced automatically: a commit's
author email is frequently a GitHub `noreply` address and is unverified
either way. Organizations using that form still need their people listed
here individually to get through the check.
_corporate_format.reference: pointer to the executed agreement in the Owner's records
